# The Tool

<p class="lede">Design For Impact gives collaborators a structured place to connect project context, analytical choices, and decision-ready communication.</p>

---

## Tool + Guide

The combined Tool + Guide brings the worksheet and its practical prompts together in one downloadable resource.

<a class="button button-primary" href="files/design-for-impact-tool-and-guide.pdf" download>Download the Tool + Guide</a>

## Implementation guidance

Use the tool before kickoff to prepare thoughtful questions, return to it as project constraints change, and use it to shape a closeout narrative that is meaningful to the people making decisions.

## Instructor resources {#instructor-resources}

Instructor resources will be available here in a future release. They will support teaching the connection between statistical choices, collaboration, and the communication of evidence.
